treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the Hellenic Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1988)
eif_quote: Lovdata: Avtalens undertegningsdato 27-04-1988 ... Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 16-09-1991 | Art. 30(2): The Convention shall enter into force upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and its provisions shall have effect in respect of taxes on income or capital relating to the calendar year (including accounting periods closed in such year) next following that in which the Convention enters into force.
source_title: St.prp. nr. 55 (1989-90), Vedlegg: Convention Norway-Greece 1988 (English authentic text) in Stortingsforhandlinger 1989/90 vol. 2a, digitised by the National Library of Norway (Lovdata carries metadata only)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 40 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the company making the distribution is a resident of Greece, and
b) 20 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the company making the distribution is a resident of Norway.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention].

notes: Dividend caps are direction-specific with no ownership tiers (40% on Greek dividends, 20% on Norwegian dividends). Interest Art. 11(3): exempt when beneficially owned by a State, political subdivision, local authority, central bank or tax-exempt State instrumentality. Protocol: only Art. 24 (Norway switch to credit method, effective 1999-01-01 by Norwegian note). Text obtained from the official Norwegian parliamentary bill (OCR of National Library scan); Lovdata has metadata only. MLI art. 8 does not apply (Greece reserved art. 8(3)(a)). MLI WHT effect 2022-01-01 per map.json.
